newsitem.title: USA: Tseng Labs sees Q4 charge $11 to $14 mln.
newsitem.headline: Tseng Labs sees Q4 charge $11 to $14 mln.

text.p: Tseng Labs Inc said Monday it expects to incur a one-time charge of $11-$14 million in the fourth quarter.
Tseng, which supplies graphics accelerators and video products for personal computers, also said it expects to incur a significant loss in the quarter.
It said the losses were in line with its decision to focus future technology efforts on its 3D Graphics Roadmap product, in place of its 2D graphics technology.

The decision was reached after an extensive review of both the 3D and 2D marketplaces, and discussions with a number of customers concerning the limited potential for sales of high-end 2D graphics solutions.

Reduced sales of Tseng's 2D products and margin pressures will produce increased operating losses in the fourth quarter, and losses are expected to continue in subsequent quarters until the company's recently announced ET6300 3D graphics accelerator achieves meaningful sales, which is not expected until the 1997 third quarter.
